plain: To break a law or limit

webster.text: To pass over or beyond any limit; to surpass.

more.text: In a moral sense, to overpass any rule prescribed as the limit of duty; to break or violate a law, civil or moral.

example.quote: When we expect the law to be punctually executed, not one man in ten thousand will disobey it: it is the probable chance of escaping punishment that induces men to transgress.
example.cite: Letters from the Federal Farmer to the Republican, Letter XIII, Jan. 14, 1788
